title: Jude and the Kitchen
author: Mirabel Eastwick
blurb: Silas Nystrom, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the bakery lease runs out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
